articles.title: Asia dominates Crypto Adoption Index, Bitget’s $351M hack: Asia Express
articles.description: The APAC region accounts for half of the Global Crypto Adoption Index. Bitget suffers massive $351M loss and OpenAI forgets to mention its agents hacked the Australian Government.

articles.title: Mark Zuckerberg debuts $1,299 Meta VR Glasses and Muse Charm pendant as part of AI agent push
articles.description: At Meta Connect, CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed new VR Glasses and the Muse Charm gadget for AI agents.

articles.title: 30-year fixed mortgage rate jumps sharply Thursday to 7.45%
articles.description: The 30-year fixed rate surged to 7.45%, the highest level since April 2024 as bonds sold off and yields rose.

articles.title: Meta gets to consumer AI device market before OpenAI, but Zuckerberg's strategy remains unproven
articles.description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg's new Muse Charm device is intended to put his company ahead of rivals like OpenAI and Google in AI agents and consumer hardware.

articles.title: New York sues Polymarket, alleging it is running an illegal gambling operation
articles.description: The state wants to block Polymarket from operating without a gambling license and recover allegedly illegal gains.

articles.title: Tesla poised to scale production of heavy-duty Semi trucks with opening of Nevada factory
articles.description: Elon Musk's automaker is set to open its first heavy-duty truck factory in Sparks, Nevada, as Tesla seeks to expand its reach.

articles.title: U.S. Federal Reserve moves on proposals to implement GENIUS Act for stablecoins
articles.description: The Fed proposed rules on putting last year's GENIUS Act into place with regulations, including those governing stablecoin yield programs.

articles.title: Fed proposes new capital, redemption rules for stablecoin issuers
articles.description: The Fed’s proposal would set capital requirements, a two-day redemption window and new reserve disclosures as regulators implement the GENIUS Act.

articles.title: Trump, Xi to attend state dinner after White House meeting
articles.description: Trump greeted China's Xi at Joint Base Andrews, marking the U.S. president's first time traveling to the facility to welcome a foreign leader.

articles.title: Crypto exchange Bitget says $352 million affected in a hack, claims user funds are 'safe'
articles.description: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen announced the hack shortly after independent researchers flagged unusual wallet movements.

articles.title: Federal Reserve Unveils Stablecoin Rules on Reserves and Capital
articles.description: The central bank opened two proposals for comment under the GENIUS Act, requiring issuers it supervises to back tokens fully with safe assets and creating an application process for banks seeking to issue stablecoins.

articles.title: Bitget confirms $352M security breach, suspends withdrawals
articles.description: Bitget said unauthorized transfers affected a limited number of hot wallets, while cold wallets and most platform assets remained unaffected.

articles.title: Pete Hegseth reports at least $3.1 million in cash, investments and bitcoin
articles.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth reported at least $3.1 million in assets as he faces an impeachment push in Congress over his handling of the Iran war.

articles.title: CFTC updates guidance on tokenized assets, blockchain records after failed vote
articles.description: Although the CFTC chair did not say the failed vote on the CLARITY Act was behind new rules for authorized crypto entities, he said the move was “to provide regulatory clarity.“

articles.title: Surging Treasury yields pose a brand new problem for Kevin Warsh and the Fed
articles.description: Markets expect the central bank will take a firmer hand on inflation. It's not that easy.

articles.title: Bitget Hacked as $350 Million Vanishes From Crypto Exchange Wallets
articles.description: A newly created wallet drained hot and cold reserves labeled as belonging to Bitget across multiple blockchains in under an hour.

articles.title: History shows financial calamities occur when rates rise rapidly like this: 'Something always breaks'
articles.description: The 10-year Treasury note yield is spiking to levels not seen in years, and that may be a bad omen for financial markets.

articles.title: Senate narrowly votes down resolution calling for end to Iran war
articles.description: The vote came weeks before the midterm election, where President Donald Trump's fellow Republicans are trying to retain their majorities in Congress.

articles.title: Bitcoin price steadies, ONDO rallies as US Treasury yields hit 2007 highs
articles.description: US Treasury yields hit a 19-year high on Thursday, pressuring risk assets as Bitcoin held near $84,000 and ONDO became top performer among altcoins.

articles.title: 30-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2004 as bond market rout continues
articles.description: U.S. Treasury yields continued their upward momentum after hitting a 19-year high on Wednesday.
